description: Returns the full text of a page, or of one section of a page, by the identifier given by search, for example ccs or ccs#specifications (identifiers of Chinese results start with zh:). Page addresses are accepted as well.

lang.description: Language of the result: en (English, the default) or zh (Chinese).

name: fetch

source_url.description: Address of the page on which the data is published

title: Page or section text
